title: Outlook: Shareable links now show as the document name in meeting descriptions
description: In Outlook for Android, shareable links now automatically show as the document name in meeting descriptions. Additionally, users can manage the link permissions on the shareable links directly from the meeting description, ensuring a more secure file sharing process.
